_about: Expression packs: which kind of GIFs and pictures each personality uses to show how it feels (expression mode, Settings > Look & feel > Avatar).
Edit freely. A copy in data/expression-packs.json (same shape, only the parts you change) is merged over this file and is kept across updates.
genre: what the pack is, in words. subjects: search words that make a search this genre. match: words a GIF's title, tags or page must have (or the picture check must see) to count as this genre.
queries: hand-picked searches per emotion (the emotion ids are in lib/looks/emotion.mjs). Searches are also made by pairing each subject with the emotion's own words.
avoid: words that keep a GIF out of this pack. Only plain search words: no bundled media, no brand or franchise names.

encourage: do or do not wise master
